title: Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 97b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.97b.3) he sent to Rav Yosef: “I found a man who had a scroll in his hand … and he said: I hired myself out to the Roman armies, and I found it among the Roman archives, and in it was written: Four thousand two hundred and ninety-one years after the creation of the world, the world will be orphaned,” etc. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Anan bar Tachlifa, and [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1418&lang=en) arrived at this reading on its own. Hyman says this is the only time that the count of years from creation is mentioned in the Talmud.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sanhedrin gives Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa and the figure 4,291 years from creation. Heilprin’s Chanan entry cross-refers to Anan. Hyman attributes that alternate form to Dikdukei Soferim and treats the chronological formula here as unique.
